release_notes: {offer} on a landing is now the signed link through the tracker, exactly like Keitaro: the button click is counted in the funnel, and parameters appended to it ({offer}&offer_id=…, {offer}&sub_id_5=…) reach the tracker instead of a foreign domain. This also fixes streams with "offer selection: before", whose clicks silently showed as zero in reports, and external redirect landings now actually receive the documented _subid/_token pair their offer link needs.
